AUTHOR: Marjadi
TITLE: A video monitoring and computational system for estimating migratory juvenile fish abundance in river systems
REGION: Monument (Herring) River fish ladder exit, Bourne, Massachusetts, USA
SPECIES: Juvenile river herring (Alosa pseudoharengus, A. aestivalis) treated as one class
DATA: Own continuous monochrome/IR video, June-Nov 2017; 8 training videos (14,785 frames, 48,182 boxes); 10 evaluation videos (19,498 frames marked by Zooniverse volunteers/experts); 188-frame expert count set
V_EV: Fig. 3 caption: 'Examples of extracted video frames to show fish passing in a range of conditions (e.g., day and night, different turbidity'; Table 5 F1 by time of day/cloud cover/moon phase.
D2: Training: 8 videos (89/10/1 train/val/test frames); evaluation: separate set of 10 videos
D_EV: Model evaluation dataset: 'To evaluate model performance on new data, we processed a second set of videos (10), which spanned a range of conditions and time periods.'
R_EV: Video specifications: single site, 2017 season; 'We installed the camera from 08 June 2017 to 17 November 2017' - training and evaluation from same deployment.
C_EV: Frame extraction: 'To avoid overcounting fish present in multiple video frames as they swim through, we extracted frames at intervals based on an average fish frame-residence rate'
E_EV: Numerical count performance: 'the count evaluation dataset reported 3339 fish in 189 images, while the top model counted 3686 fish... approximately a 9.4% difference'; Fig. 5 daily juvenile passage estimates.
ARCH: YOLOv5 (selected), ResNet101 and Inception v3 categorical-count classifiers; optional Salman-style grayscale/background-subtraction/optical-flow preprocessing
METR: Precision, recall, F1 (presence/absence, categorical count), count difference, % difference, Pearson r
NOTE: Evaluation frames were sampled from preliminary YOLO-positive and YOLO-negative frames, then labelled by Zooniverse volunteers (3 votes) and checked by experts. E1 = counts vs expert counts plus daily passage time series (Fig. 5). Performance by month/time of day/cloud/moon reported as illumination proxies (V6=P). Viewing area 76.2 cm to contrast board (V4). Code GitHub WHOIGit/HerringRunner; data USGS ScienceBase.
